nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced; at 6.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 2> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
integrated_multimodal_description
<Picture 1> and <Picture 2> both use the supplied image as the first-frame and last-frame reference, creating a seamless loop.
Warm cinematic photorealism, intimate everyday atmosphere, realistic skin texture, natural facial micro-expressions, shallow depth of field, soft bedside lighting, and subtle handheld movement.
[Shot 1] A continuous 6-second first-person POV shot. The viewer is reclining in bed and holding a black smartphone vertically in one hand while having a video call with his adult girlfriend. Preserve the exact opening composition from <Picture 1>: the hand position, phone shape and angle, screen layout, softly illuminated bedroom, white bedding, warm lamp, blurred photographs, and the girlfriend’s face, hairstyle, earrings, floral knit top, and identity.
The smartphone remains the dominant subject and occupies most of the frame. The first-person camera makes only very small, slow, natural handheld movements caused by breathing. The phone never rotates, changes shape, leaves the frame, or becomes obscured. The video-call interface, bottom controls, and small caller-preview window remain stable and do not flicker or deform.
From 00:00.000 to 00:01.200, the girlfriend holds the original warm smile, rests her cheek against one hand, maintains affectionate eye contact with the front-facing camera, and blinks naturally.
From 00:01.200 to 00:02.300, she notices something amusing. Her eyebrows rise, her eyes widen with playful surprise, and her lips part slightly. The change develops through smooth facial muscle motion rather than switching expressions abruptly.
From 00:02.300 to 00:03.400, surprise turns into a bright natural laugh. Her eyes curve gently, her nose wrinkles slightly, her cheeks lift, and her shoulders make a small realistic movement. She briefly moves a little closer to her camera while keeping her face clear and recognizable.
From 00:03.400 to 00:04.400, she makes a cute mock pout, gently puffing her cheeks and narrowing her eyes. After a brief pause, she blinks and struggles to suppress another smile. Keep the performance charming and natural, not exaggerated or cartoonish.
From 00:04.400 to 00:05.300, she relaxes into a tender expression, tilts her head slightly, gives a small affectionate nod, and smiles softly toward the viewer. Add realistic eye saccades, subtle breathing, and tiny movements of loose hair strands.
From 00:05.300 to 00:06.000, she smoothly returns to the exact pose and expression shown in <Picture 2>: cheek resting on her hand, head angle restored, eyes looking toward the camera, and the same bright smile. The phone, holding hand, bedroom background, lighting, framing, screen interface, and every major object return precisely to their first-frame positions, allowing the final frame to loop seamlessly into the opening frame.
Maintain the girlfriend’s facial identity, age, hairstyle, clothing, jewelry, skin tone, and proportions in every frame. Preserve realistic screen reflections and slight digital-video compression. No cuts, camera switches, zooms, scene changes, duplicated fingers, extra hands, facial morphing, drifting features, changing teeth, warped phone edges, interface corruption, subtitles, logos, or readable text.
overall_soundscape
Quiet bedroom ambience, faint fabric movement, subtle phone-speaker texture, natural breathing, and a few soft nonverbal giggles from the girlfriend. No intelligible dialogue.
non_diegetic_music
Soft, intimate lo-fi piano with a very light ambient pad, low volume, warm and unobtrusive.
